She pauses over an old photograph of her maid uniform before slipping it into an inner pocket. Her blue jacket sleeves rest against the case; gentle afternoon light reveals the practical preparations and restrained emotion of choosing a journey for herself.

blueprints.title: 早坂爱 · 深夜阳台的黑咖啡
blueprints.description: 四宫宅佣人区的窄阳台，结束一天工作的她靠着栏杆喝黑咖啡，发圈已经取下、头发散着；望着宅邸灯火，脸上是只属于凌晨一点的、没有观众的疲惫。
blueprints.action: 散着头发靠栏杆喝黑咖啡，望向宅邸灯光放松下来。
blueprints.promptProse: Loose blonde hair falls over Ai’s cream cardigan as she rests her forearms on a narrow balcony rail. Both hands cradle a ceramic cup of black coffee, her blue eyes lowered with the quiet fatigue of a late shift. A scrunchie rests beside the cup. Close framing fills the canvas with her face, hands and the wooden rail; the mansion windows shine softly behind her in the night air, with no border or inset.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 清晨的报纸配送路线
blueprints.description: 清晨五点半的住宅区，她骑着自行车穿梭在还亮着路灯的街道，车筐里整齐码着卷好的报纸；呼出的白气与渐亮的天色，是她不为人知的日常开头。
blueprints.action: 清晨五点半的住宅区，她骑着自行车穿梭在还亮着路灯的街道，车筐里整齐码着卷好的报纸
blueprints.promptProse: Kei steadies her bicycle beside a residential letterbox and lifts a rolled newspaper from the neatly packed front basket. Her blue windbreaker is closed against the cool air, silver-grey hair held back by a black headband. The street lamps still glow as dawn reaches the road. A medium view follows the paper, basket and focused blue eyes, showing the practical beginning of a day few classmates see.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 白银家的家计簿
blueprints.description: 家中矮桌，她盘腿坐着核对家计簿，计算器、超市传单和笔袋一字排开；发现本月结余比预期多时，嘴角忍不住上扬，又立刻收敛成「理所当然」的表情。
blueprints.action: 家中矮桌，她盘腿坐着核对家计簿，计算器、超市传单和笔袋一字排开
blueprints.promptProse: Cross-legged at the low table, Kei checks a household ledger beside a calculator and supermarket leaflets. Her cream sweater sleeves are pushed clear of the pencil. A slightly larger balance than expected brings a brief smile before she resumes her composed look. Warm afternoon light catches her blue eyes, long silver-grey hair and the orderly line of papers in a quiet horizontal view of careful everyday planning.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 初中部学生会的决算
blueprints.description: 放学后学生会室，她把收据按日期排开贴进账本，动作精准得像机器；其他成员离开后，她对着平掉的账目轻轻舒一口气，露出小小的成就感。
blueprints.action: 放学后学生会室，她把收据按日期排开贴进账本，动作精准得像机器
blueprints.promptProse: Kei aligns receipts by date before attaching them to the student-council ledger. Her dark uniform and white collar stay crisp as she presses the last corner flat with one fingertip. The room has grown quiet after the meeting, and a small relieved breath softens her blue-eyed expression. Late-afternoon light on the desk reveals the finished page, tidy supplies and the unobtrusive pleasure of a balanced account.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 超市关门前的时间差攻撃
blueprints.description: 晚上八点五十分的超市，她目标明确地走向贴半价标签的熟食区，手指在商品上方悬停一秒计算性价比；买到划算商品时的得意只敢在走出店门后露出来。
blueprints.action: 晚上八点五十分的超市，她目标明确地走向贴半价标签的熟食区，手指在商品上方悬停一秒计算性价比
blueprints.promptProse: Near closing time, Kei pauses beside the supermarket’s prepared-food shelf with one hand over a discounted container. She compares two price labels before placing the better choice into her basket. Her blue windbreaker and practical shoes suit the quick errand. Bright aisle lighting frames the focused blue eyes and the restrained hint of satisfaction that follows a sensible purchase, without turning the shelf into readable pricing data.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 深夜台灯下的数学
blueprints.description: 家中书桌，台灯下她快速解着超出年级水平的数学题，手边放着记账用的同一个计算器；解出答案时习惯性地去够杯子，才发现茶早就凉了。

blueprints.promptProse: Under the desk lamp, Kei works through a difficult mathematics exercise, pencil moving beside the same calculator used for household accounts. She reaches automatically toward a cup, then notices that the tea has gone cold. Silver-grey hair falls over her cream sweater as concentration shifts to mild surprise. The close seated view keeps the notebook, pencil and blue-eyed expression clear while the rest of the room remains quiet.

blueprints.title: 白银圭 · 打折书籍的权衡
blueprints.description: 书店特价区，她抱着两本只能买一本的书来回比较，指尖在书脊上敲打；最终放回一本时的忍痛表情，和回家路上对买到那本的珍惜，是她式的幸福。
blueprints.action: 书店特价区，她抱着两本只能买一本的书来回比较，指尖在书脊上敲打
blueprints.promptProse: Kei holds two discounted books against her school uniform, studying each spine before reluctantly returning one to the shelf. The remaining volume stays carefully supported in both hands. Her blue eyes soften with the private pleasure of a considered choice. Warm bookstore light touches the black headband and long silver-grey hair, centering the small compromise and the value she gives the book she can take home.
